stations.name: Port-aux-Basques
stations.note: Newfoundland Railway station; on a stretch drawn as a straight estimate

trips.note: Local express No. 15: St. John's 5.00 p.m. Monday and Wednesday for points to Corner Brook (2.08 p.m. next day): the days and hour of the Newfoundland Railway notices of July 1948; times of the May 1949 folder. Coaches, dining car and standard sleeping cars (1949 folder). Shown in Pacific time: five and a half hours earlier than the Newfoundland summer time printed (an hour and a half ahead of Atlantic standard time).

Local express No. 15: St. John's 5.00 p.m. Saturday through to Port-aux-Basques (9.45 p.m. Sunday), connecting there with S.S. Burgeo for the South Coast and at Lewisporte with S.S. Springdale (notices of July 1948); times of the May 1949 folder. Coaches, dining car and standard sleeping cars (1949 folder). Shown in Pacific time: five and a half hours earlier than the Newfoundland summer time printed (an hour and a half ahead of Atlantic standard time).

Foreign express No. 1: St. John's 5.00 p.m. Tuesday and Thursday to Port-aux-Basques (6.40 p.m. next day) for the North Sydney steamer: the days and hour of the notices of July 1948; times of the May 1949 folder. Coaches, dining car and standard sleeping cars (1949 folder). Shown in Pacific time: five and a half hours earlier than the Newfoundland summer time printed (an hour and a half ahead of Atlantic standard time).

trips.name: The Overland Limited
trips.note: The Overland Limited, No. 3: St. John's 10.00 a.m. Sundays, making direct connection for foreign points (notice of 9 July 1948), Port-aux-Basques 8.50 a.m. Monday for the 9.30 a.m. steamer; times of the May 1949 folder. Coaches, dining car, standard sleeping cars, compartment observation car. Shown in Pacific time: five and a half hours earlier than the Newfoundland summer time printed (an hour and a half ahead of Atlantic standard time).

trips.name: Bonavista train
trips.note: Train for points to Bonavista, St. John's 9.00 p.m. Wednesday, sleeper for Trinity attached (Newfoundland Railway notice, 7 July 1948). Not in any timetable in hand: the times to Clarenville are ESTIMATED on No. 15's running times; from Clarenville it is taken to be mixed No. 27 (Thursday 5.30 a.m., May 1949 folder). To Bonavista (No. 27 from Clarenville). Shown in Pacific time: five and a half hours earlier than the Newfoundland summer time printed (an hour and a half ahead of Atlantic standard time).

Express No. 2: Port-aux-Basques 9.00 a.m. Sunday, Wednesday and Friday (from the North Sydney steamer) to St. John's 10.45 a.m. next day. May 1949 folder; the 1948 notices do not give the eastbound trains. Coaches, dining car, standard sleeping cars; compartment observation car from Port-aux-Basques Wednesdays. Shown in Pacific time: five and a half hours earlier than the Newfoundland summer time printed (an hour and a half ahead of Atlantic standard time).

Express No. 14: Port-aux-Basques 9.00 a.m. Tuesday to St. John's 12.45 p.m. Wednesday. May 1949 folder; the 1948 notices do not give the eastbound trains. Coaches, dining car and standard sleeping cars (1949 folder). Shown in Pacific time: five and a half hours earlier than the Newfoundland summer time printed (an hour and a half ahead of Atlantic standard time).

Express No. 16: Corner Brook 11.00 a.m. Thursday and Saturday to St. John's 7.00 a.m. next day. May 1949 folder; the 1948 notices do not give the eastbound trains. Coaches, dining car and standard sleeping cars (1949 folder). Shown in Pacific time: five and a half hours earlier than the Newfoundland summer time printed (an hour and a half ahead of Atlantic standard time).
